title: Gemini Canvas keeps dying mid-project (lag, one reply, stuck ‘thinking’, reload = gone) — anyone else?
author: Trashy_io
selftext:
I’m trying to build in Gemini Canvas and it’s stopped working its magic:

	• Super laggy / stutters

	• Sometimes replies once, then stops responding

	• If I reload, my chat/project state doesn’t pop up in my recent chats

Project is around 3,000 lines of code now, so I’m wondering… did I hit a limit?

Setup: 

	•	Device: Windows 

	•	Browser: Chrome

	•	Extensions: None currently 

	•	Happens on: Wi-Fi 

Tried: refresh, new tab, and reset. Any known fixes or workflow for larger projects? This is my first time running into this issue and the project is only 1/3 of the way to a demo 😅

Is this a known Canvas issue right now, or is there a best practice for big projects (split files / export / new thread per module)?

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Update: Working inside of chat only seems to be my only solution at the moment. Still making progress but at a 1/10 of the speed before the project grew so large

comments.author: BadHorse22
comments.body: I had better luck using Claude once things got that big. Even using the free tier. Gemini was wonderful in the beginning but at a certain point it seems to struggle

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Thank you! ill give it a shot I have yet to experiment with Claude at all, what would you say is the limit for claud? I'm guessing Ill end up with well over 8,000 lines of code just for the core game mechanics and items lol
